description: NaSbO₃ is Orthorhombic Perovskite structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.74 Å. Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing SbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 29°. There are four shorter (2.01 Å) and two longer (2.02 Å) Sb-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and two equivalent Sb atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Sb atoms to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂Sb₂ tetrahedra.
